headline: NASA launches the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope
standfirst: A new mission has begun to uncover the darkest secrets of our universe.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: A SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket launched NASA’s new space telescope from Florida on Sunday morning.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The telescope is now starting a three-month journey to reach an orbit one million miles away.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This advanced tool is designed to help scientists explore the darkest mysteries of the universe.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Keep an eye on its three-month journey as it travels to its final destination in space.

caption:
The NASA Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has officially launched into space to study the universe.

This powerful new observatory is currently traveling a million miles to reach its final orbit. It aims to shed light on some of the deepest cosmic mysteries we have yet to solve.
